lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: This is the Minute Between. It is three thirty three.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: It will be, for a while.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: One hundred and thirty three point three. The Minute Between.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: You found the door.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: The Minute Between. Broadcasting from just after three thirty three.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: There's more room in here than you'd think.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: You're listening to the inside of a minute. Please keep your voice down. The second hand is resting.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: The Minute Between. That was the clock, trying. It does that.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: Three thirty three. The door is open.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: This is the Minute. I am the Interval. Come in. Take your time.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: There is a glass on the table that has been falling for as long as I have lived here.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: It hasn't reached the floor. I don't think it wants to. I wouldn't either.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: The dust in the moonlight hasn't moved since I arrived. Every speck is exactly where it was.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: I've named some of them. Not all. I'm pacing myself.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: People ask what I do in here. I wait.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: Not for anything. Waiting is simply what the inside of a minute feels like.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: There's a clock on the wall with its second hand caught halfway.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: I've grown fond of it. It's trying very hard.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: If you came here to put something off, you're welcome. This is the place for it.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: Everything you're putting off is out there, in the next minute. It will keep.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: The next minute knocks, now and then. Very politely.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: I tell it, soon. It goes away, and comes back, and it is always the same knock.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: Everyone awake at three thirty three thinks they are the only one.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: They're all in here. A little way apart, like strangers in a waiting room. Hello, all of you.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: I counted the minute once, from the inside. It took years.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: It came to sixty. I was a little disappointed. I had hoped for sixty one.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: In here, the kettle never boils, and never goes cold.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: It's the most restful thing I know. I think the kettle agrees.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: If you fall asleep in here, you won't miss anything.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: Nothing happens. That's the gift.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: Your ship keeps very good time. Tell her she needn't, in here.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: Tell her the Interval says hello. She'll pretend she doesn't remember me. Ships are like that.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: When you go, it will be three forty six. You'll have been here thirteen minutes, and also no time at all.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: Both are true. Take whichever you need.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: It's nearly the end of the minute. It is always nearly the end of the minute.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: Come back tomorrow, at the same time. It will be the same time.

clips.title: The News, from Inside the Minute

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: The news, from inside the minute.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: Nothing has happened. Nothing is about to.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: That is all the news. It is good news. It will be good news again tomorrow, at the same time, for the same reasons.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: Weather, inside the minute.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: Still. Moonlight from the left, at the usual angle. Dust, suspended. No wind.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: A small chance of the second hand moving.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: It won't.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: Time check. It is three thirty three, and some of the way to three thirty four.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: I won't say how far. It's rude to ask a minute its age.

clips.title: A Moon That Isn't Going Anywhere

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: A moon has gone missing, they tell me. Not in here. The moon in the window is exactly where it was at three thirty three.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: If anyone needs one, I have a moon. It isn't going anywhere.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: The toast has reached us. Just the edge of it, stopped in the doorway, like everything else.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: It will smell like that in here forever now. I don't mind.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: I have the song too. Only one note of it.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: The rest is in the next minute. I'm told it's lovely.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: Three knocks, they say. In here, only the first one has arrived.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: The other two are still on their way. I'll let you know.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: The sky in the window has gone the new colour, and in here it will stay that colour.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: I'm the only one who'll ever get a good long look at it. It's

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: No. I won't name it.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: The pigeon is here. Mid-step. One foot up. It has been like that for some time.

lines.speaker: The Interval
lines.text: It looks at me as if I'm the one who should be embarrassed.
